> **Required package:** [`FluentMap.Generators`](https://www.nuget.org/packages/FluentMap.Generators)

## Problem solved

Generate mapping registration and supported materializers at build time.

## When to use it

Use this capability when the column shape and .NET model should remain separated by explicit, reviewable configuration.

## Example

```bash
dotnet add package FluentMap.Generators

// Startup
config.AddGeneratedMappings();
```

## How it works

FluentMap registers typed metadata and applies it through the matching materialization path. SQL, connections, parameters, and lifecycle remain responsibilities of the application and Dapper.

## Constraints

:::caution
The generator scans the current compilation, does not parse SQL, and does not replace FluentMapper.Validate().
:::
